description: Fetch the full set of photos for a single Google Hotels property via SerpAPI. Requires a `property_token` taken from a google_hotels_search result. Paginate with next_page_token.

next_page_token.description: Token from a prior response to fetch the next page of photos.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

property_token.description: Property token from a google_hotels_search result identifying the property whose photos to fetch.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_hotels_photos
title: Get Google Hotels Property Photos (SerpAPI)
